title: Publish task-sync directories through one fail-closed no-replace helper instead of a directory hard-link fallback
outcome: Publish task-sync directories through one fail-closed no-replace helper instead of a directory hard-link fallback
acceptance: directory::write_documents, directory::write_with and the progress journal publish directories through one shared helper that uses an atomic no-replace directory move and fails closed with a typed refusal where the platform cannot provide it; no path hard-links a directory or falls back to an exists-check plus plain rename.
Existing collision, retry and interruption semantics are unchanged on platforms that support atomic no-replace moves, shown by the existing directory and progress tests passing unchanged.
A deterministic test forces the unsupported no-replace case and shows a typed refusal with nothing published and no partial directory left behind.

completion.summary:
Landed b2f1f473 on origin/master, a fast-forward from a3abda8d, with tree c2447d3b, the gated freeze cfea41c6. The implementation is by 11323 (Codex), carried unchanged by Engram::Opus.
- C1: task-sync directory publication now goes through one helper, src/task_sync/publication.rs.
  - It uses a no-replace directory move: rustix renameat_with NOREPLACE on Linux, Android, Redox and Apple; MoveFileExW without REPLACE_EXISTING on Windows.
  - It is called from directory::write_documents, write_folder_documents, write_with and progress::journal::publish.
  - Where the move is unsupported, it fails closed with the typed refusal task_sync_publication_unsupported.
  - There is no hard-link fallback and no exists-check plus rename.
- C2: other I/O errors pass through unchanged. The existing directory and progress tests are unchanged and pass.
- C3: deterministic seam tests force the unsupported move. They show the typed refusal, nothing published, no stage left behind, and recovery on the next attempt.
- Validation:
  - Windows full gate test-44d25fef-0f6f-42a3-9305-ebc156c78727 PASS: 12/12 stages, 3/3 preflight, expected = before = after = cfea41c6.
  - Mac Unix run (Merger note e97ec224): check, clippy, task_sync:: 342/0/2 and task_prepare_cli 12/0/0 on the byte-identical input, carried over per note 3f714960.
  - Reviews: r1 had nothing at Medium or higher, r2 was clean, and carries r3 and r4 were clean at Low.
  - Evaluation 36945c58 PASS 3/3.
- Readiness was ready on all 6 stores, both pre-commit (build 8b9500c3) and post-commit (build 632989c9, clean b2f1f473).
